descriptionChirho: Sense of burning, kindling fire, or being aflame -- both literal fire (Ezek 24:10, Obad 1:18) and metaphorical burning such as inflaming with wine or passion (Isa 5:11, Prov 26:23). Includes Hifil causative 'kindle/inflame'. Arabic awqada (أَوْقِدِ) / iltahaba (اِلْتَهَبَ), Korean 지피다/타오르다, Swahili -washa/-waka.

Sense of hotly pursuing, chasing, or persecuting someone with intensity -- from the homonymous root דָּלַק II meaning 'to pursue with burning eagerness' (Gen 31:36, 1 Sam 17:53, Lam 4:19, Ps 7:13, Ps 10:2). Arabic ṭārada (طَارَدَ), Korean 쫓다/박해하다, Swahili -fuatia kwa bidii.
